scope: Evidence-backed additions and a bounded follow-up queue. Not an exhaustive list of every BC patch ever issued. No candidate is production-ready artwork.

statusDefinitions.documented-missing: Physical museum object or official agency publication establishes a design absent from baseline labels/organizations; exact reconstruction still needs image review.
statusDefinitions.collector-candidate: Collector/dealer/photographer evidence identifies a likely missing design; issue authenticity and dates remain unverified.
statusDefinitions.documented-needs-comparison: A physical uniform component is documented, but its exact design, wearing agency or relationship to baseline remains unresolved; image-level and attribution review required.
statusDefinitions.documented-needs-image: Agency confirms patch existence; specific visual specimen still required.
statusDefinitions.held-unverified-issue: Object exists but evidence does not establish official operational issue.
statusDefinitions.held-printed-design-only: Printed emblem is documented but a physical cloth version is not.
statusDefinitions.held-planned-only: Source describes future development, not confirmed production.

designPrinciples: A specimen photograph is evidence for a design, not automatically a new design.
Keep organization, design family, wording/role, palette, manufacture/backing, and evidence status in separate fields.
Generated recolours and a physical issue need different evidence states even when they share artwork.
A detached title or qualification tab can form a documented assembly with a main patch without becoming a duplicate combined design.
Shared template geometry does not establish organizational or historical identity.
Save source documents once and refer to image/page/crop coordinates from multiple sightings; do not duplicate the same museum image for each accession component.
Source dates, catalogue dates, first-seen dates and verified issue periods must remain distinct.

assetPolicy.note: Rights and attribution must be assessed at the individual source before importing imagery. Ingenium pages present an apparent mismatch between the displayed license label and linked license; resolve it before reuse. Museum catalogue descriptions do not grant artwork or photograph reuse rights.

baselineComparisonNote: baselineIds identify nearest comparison targets, not confirmed matches or shared geometry; an empty list means no close target was identified in this review.

relatedInventories.note: Separate bounded museum-source pass: 23 potential additional design/variant specimens, 19 specimens linked to existing research candidates, 7 baseline corroborations, 5 scope reviews and 1 unresolved rank item. Do not add these counts to design totals.
